research_question: How do the three leading models' continuous performance and rate error vary across physiological scenarios, once the scenario/subject confound is respected?
no_training: Frozen test predictions only (MMECG 3 models x 3 seeds x 11 folds; CR_RVS 3 models x 5 folds).
confound: Scenarios are unevenly distributed over subjects (MMECG: sleep appears in 3 subjects, post-exercise in 6; two folds are normal breathing only). Every statistic is therefore computed per (subject, scenario) first, seeds averaged, then aggregated over subjects, and the subject count is reported with every cell.
aggregation: per (subject, scenario): median window PCC and RR error; across subjects: median with IQR and range; RR gated at rr_coverage >= 0.80 per (subject, scenario, seed)
